subject: Vendr evidence guardianship change request
messages:
From: Amanda Ortiz <amanda.ortiz@vendr.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Temporary evidence steward for Brightleaf onboarding

Hi Camila,

Quick note from Vendr as we finalize the Brightleaf onboarding: their security team has requested a short window where our customer (Brightleaf) can nominate a temporary steward to upload a small set of encrypted proofs to the Vendr portal on their behalf. Because Brightleaf uses an external integrator, they want to delegate custody to a Redwood contact while we complete HSM access proofing.

Can Redwood accept a one-week temporary stewardship for the following uploads (SOC 2 snippets + CAIQ export)? We need confirmation from an authorized Redwood security contact and a scan of who will hold the steward key.

Attachments: vendr_temp-steward_consent.pdf (template), evidence-inventory.csv (list of expected files)

Thanks,
Amanda Ortiz
Onboarding Lead, Vendr
--
Vendr | https://vendr.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Amanda Ortiz <amanda.ortiz@vendr.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 10:31:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Temporary evidence steward for Brightleaf onboarding

Forwarding Vendr's ask — Brightleaf wants Redwood to act as a temporary steward while we finish HSM/KMS exchanges. Key points: one-week window, SOC 2 snippets and CAIQ export, Vendr will provide the consent template.

Jonas / Monica — security + legal check: is a one-week steward (upload-only, encrypted artifacts, no key escrow) acceptable under our current onboarding policy? If yes, we should designate the steward account (I can operate the uploads, but want an explicit approval).

Karthik — ops: if approved, can you confirm the process for ephemeral upload credentials (time-limited, IP-restricted)? Vendr linked a portal consent URL and sent an inventory.

I included Amanda for transparency. If we need contract redlines for the consent template, loop in legal; otherwise a short signed approval should suffice.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Architect, Vendor Security Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Amanda Ortiz <amanda.ortiz@vendr.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Temporary evidence steward for Brightleaf onboarding

Camila — thanks for flagging. Quick responses: 

- Security: acceptable with constraints. Condition the steward access on upload-only credentials, encryption at rest with customer-managed key, and an audit log export at handoff. No private keys held by Redwood.
- Legal: I reviewed the consent PDF; it looks fine as a short-term operational consent. Please ensure the consent includes an explicit end date and revocation clause.
- Ops (Karthik): Karthik, please provision ephemeral S3 presign credentials limited to the Vendr upload host and set TTL = 8 days. Also enable object-level server-side encryption (SSE-C or KMS) per the customer's preference.

Camila, if you're able to accept steward duties operationally, we can approve once Amanda confirms the precise upload host and share the consent with signatures. Monica — I'll need you to confirm the audit log export format (CSV/JSON) we will supply at the end of the window.

Jonas
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Amanda Ortiz <amanda.ortiz@vendr.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 09:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Temporary evidence steward for Brightleaf onboarding

Thanks all — confirming details from Brightleaf and Vendr side: 

- Upload host: uploads.vendr.com (TLS enforced), S3-backed bucket vendr-evidence-us-east-1
- Encryption: Brightleaf requests SSE-KMS using their key; Vendr will accept SSE-KMS with customer key ID provided at upload time.
- Consent: signed by Brightleaf security contact (attached). Link: https://vendr.app/onboarding/consent/9a6f
- Audit requirement: final audit export in CSV with columns [object_key, uploader, timestamp, sha256, acl] — acceptable?

Camila — Brightleaf has nominated you as the temporary steward. If Redwood can provision the presign flow and perform the uploads during the week of 2027-11-15 to 2027-11-22, Brightleaf will revoke steward access on 2027-11-22. Please reply with an explicit acceptance and a note about any limitations.

Attachments: vendr_temp-steward_consent_signed.pdf

Best,
Amanda Ortiz
Vendr Onboarding Team
